sources.title: A generative-AI-based design methodology for car frontal forms design
sources.snippet: However, there are currently few design methodologies based on generative AIs in the academic community to improve the efficiency of industrial designers and optimize the design process. This study introduces a creative and practical methodology for designing car frontal forms based on generative AIs.
